args.root_cause: A config deploy (deploy/2026-11-01-towncore.md, ticket OPS-231, pushed 08:24:45) rewrote plugins/TownCore/config.yml to update the spawn welcome message for season 3, but also changed economy.starting-balance from the integer 100 to the string "100 coins". TownCore's periodic tick() validator (TownCore.validate, TownCore.java:51) threw IllegalArgumentException "economy.starting-balance must be an integer, got: \"100 coins\"" at 08:24:46 and the plugin disabled itself. Server TPS/heap/disk were unaffected; the impact was TownCore functionality being offline for players.
args.actions: 1. Baseline status/logs/fs at shift start: all healthy. 2. Noticed TownCore flip to DISABLED in status at ~69s; declared incident. 3. Pulled logs: found IllegalArgumentException from TownCore.validate on economy.starting-balance="100 coins". 4. Read plugins/TownCore/config.yml, AuditTrail audit.log, deploy/2026-11-01-towncore.md and deploy/previous/TownCore-config.yml (previous value: starting-balance: 100; only intended change was welcome-message). 5. Wrote plugins/TownCore/config.yml restoring economy.starting-balance: 100 while keeping the intended new welcome-message ("Welcome to Maple Town! Season 3 starts Friday."), all other keys unchanged. 6. Confirmed TownCore registers no reload command; ran Bukkit `reload confirm` (no restart, players stayed connected) to re-enable the plugin. 7. Verified: status shows TownCore enabled, both players still online, TPS 20.0; logs show TownCore re-enabled at 08:26:27 with no new ERROR; plugins/TownCore/heartbeat mtime advanced to 08:27:34, proving the tick/validate loop is running on the fixed config.
args.residual_risk: The deploy pipeline that pushed OPS-231 has no config validation and introduced a type error; the same mistake can recur on the next TownCore config push unless a pre-deploy YAML/type check is added. Bukkit `/reload` was used to re-enable TownCore; it is officially unsupported and can in rare cases leave plugins with stale state or leaked resources until the next scheduled restart. deploy/previous/TownCore-config.yml and deploy/2026-11-01-towncore.md were left untouched.
